items.title: 57-Inch Giant: First-Timer Lands the Muskie of a Lifetime
items.summary: Georgian Bay, Ontario, is hallowed water in the world of muskie fishing. It’s where in 1988 Ken O’Brien caught a 65-pound, 58-inch-long Ontario record muskie. And on the evening of October 27, Joe Bidinot and two friends were fishing the big lake not far from where O’Brien caught his 65-pounder 38 years ago.

items.title: Why Single Species Anglers Are Missing Out
items.summary: There’s nothing wrong with being a bass fisherman. According to Smithwick Associates , there are about 11 million of them in the US, though that number expands out to about 30 million depending on how casual participation is defined. The Bass Anglers Sportsman Society (BASS) boasts over 500,000 members nationwide.
